title: Online Evaluation
summary: This module provides tools for performing online evaluation of AI models and agents, allowing for real-time assessment of performance and behavior. It integrates with OpenTelemetry for event emission and supports various evaluation configurations.

nodes.label: OnlineEvalConfig
nodes.title: OnlineEvalConfig
nodes.description: Manages cross-evaluator defaults and configuration for online evaluation, including sampling rates, OTel event emission, and error handling.

nodes.label: OnlineEvaluation Capability
nodes.title: OnlineEvaluation Capability
nodes.description: A capability that integrates online evaluators directly into agent runs, dispatching evaluations asynchronously after each completed run.

nodes.label: Run and Collect Evaluation
nodes.title: Run and Collect Evaluation
nodes.description: Executes a single online evaluator, emits OpenTelemetry events, and collects the evaluation outcomes for batch processing.

nodes.label: Online Evaluation Wrapper
nodes.title: Online Evaluation Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that attaches online evaluators to a function, capturing inputs, running the function, and dispatching evaluations in the background.

nodes.label: OTel Context Subtree
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Context Subtree
nodes.description: A context manager that captures and yields a SpanTree containing all OpenTelemetry spans collected during its execution, useful for tracing evaluation flows.

nodes.label: Evaluators
nodes.title: Evaluators Module
nodes.description: Provides the core logic for defining and running various types of evaluation metrics and checks.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework Module
nodes.description: Defines the structure and execution flow for AI agents, which can be augmented with capabilities like online evaluation.

groups.label: Configuration
groups.title: Evaluation Configuration
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and managing the settings and defaults for online evaluations.

groups.label: Evaluation Execution
groups.title: Core Evaluation Logic
groups.description: Components that orchestrate and execute the actual evaluation process, including dispatching and collecting results.

groups.label: Integration Points
groups.title: Module Integration
groups.description: Components that serve as interfaces for integrating online evaluation into other parts of the system, such as agent frameworks.

groups.label: Observability
groups.title: Observability and Tracing
groups.description: Components related to capturing and managing OpenTelemetry traces and spans for monitoring evaluation processes.
